Title: Cyrena.PlatformIO - ProjectPlanExtensions
Summary: Extension methods on DevelopPlan for indexing PlatformIO project structures. Defines the default plan layout with feature-based organization and ESP-IDF dynamic indexing.
Content:
## Cyrena.PlatformIO.Extensions.ProjectPlanExtensions

Static extension methods on `DevelopPlan` that define the PlatformIO project structure.

### Methods

#### `IndexPlatformIODefaultPlan(this DevelopPlan plan)`

Configures the default PlatformIO project structure. Called once during `PlatformIOBuilder.ConfigureAsync`.

**Structure:**

```
include/
  ├── *.h                          (writable)  → prefix: include_h_
  └── {feature}/
        ├── definitions/
        │     └── *.h              (writable)  → prefix: include_{feature}_definitions_h_
        ├── actions/
        │     └── *.h              (writable)  → prefix: include_{feature}_actions_h_
        └── internals/
              └── *.h              (writable)  → prefix: include_{feature}_internals_h_

src/
  ├── *.c                          (writable)  → prefix: c_
  ├── *.cpp                        (writable)  → prefix: cpp_
  └── {feature}/
        ├── actions/
        │     ├── *.c              (writable)  → prefix: src_{feature}_actions_c_
        │     └── *.cpp            (writable)  → prefix: src_{feature}_actions_cpp_
        └── internals/
              ├── *.c              (writable)  → prefix: src_{feature}_internals_c_
              └── *.cpp            (writable)  → prefix: src_{feature}_internals_cpp_

lib/
  └── {library}/
        ├── library.json           (read-only)  → prefix: {library}_json_
        ├── library.properties     (read-only)  → prefix: {library}_props_
        ├── *.h                    (read-only)  → prefix: {library}_h_
        └── src/
              ├── *.cpp            (read-only)  → prefix: {library}_src_cpp_
              ├── *.c              (read-only)  → prefix: {library}_src_c_
              └── *.h              (read-only)  → prefix: {library}_src_h_

data/
  ├── *.txt                        (writable)  → prefix: data_txt_
  └── *.json                       (writable)  → prefix: data_json_

Root:
  └── platformio.ini               (read-only)  → prefix: ini_platformio
```

**Key behaviors:**
- Feature folders are auto-discovered from existing directories in `include/` and `src/`
- Each feature gets structured sub-folders: `definitions/`, `actions/`, `internals/` in `include/`; `actions/`, `internals/` in `src/`
- Any `.h` files found directly in `src/` or in feature roots (outside structured sub-folders) are indexed as **read-only**
- `lib/` and `data/` are preserved from the old structure

#### `IndexPlatformIOEspIdf(this DevelopPlan plan)`

Dynamically adds ESP-IDF-specific files to the plan. Called from `Toolbar.razor.cs` when user switches to an ESP-IDF environment.

**Adds:**
- Root `.txt`, `.csv` files (read-only)
- `src/*.txt` (read-only)
- `components/{name}/` with `.yml` files (read-only) → prefix: `components_{name}_yml_`
- `managed_components/{name}/` with `.yml` files (read-only) → prefix: `managed_components_{name}_yml_`

**Note:** `sdkconfig.{envName}` is added separately in `Toolbar.razor.cs`, not in this method.

### File ID Prefix Conventions

| Location | Prefix | Writable |
|----------|--------|----------|
| `include/*.h` | `include_h_` | Yes |
| `include/{f}/definitions/*.h` | `include_{f}_definitions_h_` | Yes |
| `include/{f}/actions/*.h` | `include_{f}_actions_h_` | Yes |
| `include/{f}/internals/*.h` | `include_{f}_internals_h_` | Yes |
| `src/*.c` | `c_` | Yes |
| `src/*.cpp` | `cpp_` | Yes |
| `src/{f}/actions/*.c` | `src_{f}_actions_c_` | Yes |
| `src/{f}/actions/*.cpp` | `src_{f}_actions_cpp_` | Yes |
| `src/{f}/internals/*.c` | `src_{f}_internals_c_` | Yes |
| `src/{f}/internals/*.cpp` | `src_{f}_internals_cpp_` | Yes |
| `lib/{name}/` | `{name}_json_`, `{name}_props_`, `{name}_h_` | No |
| `lib/{name}/src/` | `{name}_src_cpp_`, `{name}_src_c_`, `{name}_src_h_` | No |
| `data/` | `data_txt_`, `data_json_` | Yes |
| `components/{name}/` | `components_{name}_yml_` | No |
| `managed_components/{name}/` | `managed_components_{name}_yml_` | No |
| Root | `ini_` | No |
| Root (ESP-IDF) | `txt_`, `csv_`, `sdkconfig` | No |
